blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Monday said it hoped the fare hike for public utility vehicles (PUVs) would discourage transport groups from pushing through with their planned strike. The fare adjustments, which took effect Monday, were approved to help drivers cope with the continuing impact of the Middle East crisis. The minimum fare for traditional jeepneys increased from P13 to P14 for the first four kilometers, with an additional P2 for every succeeding kilometer.
